entities.summary: Wayne Melville "Byrle" Klinck was a Canadian ice hockey player who competed in the 1956 Winter Olympics. Klinck was a member of the Kitchener-Waterloo Dutchmen who won the bronze medal for Canada in ice hockey at the 1956 Winter Olympics.
